value.rationale: This exact finite classification concerns the first nonprime Paley tournament field order and resolves a mathematically motivated center-exclusion ambiguity in the extremal VC layer. Its complete orbit classification, exceptional triple 2-design and concentrated mod-two homology establish nonpure topology not supplied by the underlying VC dimension alone, and provide canonical extension-field test data for quadratic-character incidence theory.
